# Code Anchors: Close-and-Distill Command

- `utils/close-epic.sh` — the command: the single-repo role check, the pull-request state and merge-readiness checks, the unattended post-merge conformance run read back from the published verdict and the shipped record, the interactive close with a hand-off note, the note's verification against the platform and git, the unattended distill in the close worktree, and the outcome record in the run folder.
- `utils/codex/close-epic.sh` — the codex entry point that pins the harness and runs the same shared script.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the hand-off option: close writes the note only after the epic issue is closed and the distillation branch is pushed, and tells the lead to end the session.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/close-epic.spec.ts` — pins the command's refusals, merge checks, stage order, note verification and outcome record.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/close-handoff.spec.ts` — pins close's hand-off option and the note it writes only on full success.
